name: What types of under-cabinet lighting are available for installation?

mainEntity.name: What types of under-cabinet lighting are available for installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common types include LED strips, puck lights, and linear fluorescent fixtures. LED options are popular due to their energy efficiency, long lifespan, and dimming capabilities. Puck lights offer focused illumination, while linear fixtures provide continuous, even light. When choosing, consider the cabinet lip depth and desired light output; deeper lips can conceal fixtures better. Hometelligent Inc. can assess your specific cabinet structure during an initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Available types include LED strips, puck lights, and linear fluorescent fixtures, with LEDs offering energy efficiency and versatility.
